cues: A, three hundred and fifty joules.
The work is P delta V: one point five times ten to the five, times three times ten to the minus three, which is four hundred and fifty joules.
Then delta U is Q minus W, eight hundred minus four fifty.
If you picked four hundred and fifty, you found the work, not the internal energy.
